name: Sunfeast MOMS MAGIC Butter
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, SUGAR, BUTTER (2%), INVERT SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS, IODIZED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [INS 450, INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii)], EMULSIFIERS [LECITHIN (FROM SOYABEAN), MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (FROM PALM OIL), DIACETYL TARTARIC ACID ESTER OF MONO-DIGLYCERIDES (FROM SUNFLOWER & PALM OIL)], NATURAL FLAVOUR & FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (BUTTER), COLOUR (INS 150a) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA). ALLERGEN DECLARATION: CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOY. MAY CONTAINS NUTS, SULPHITES.
